content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.rationale:
Section 9 is the only warranty provision in the Agreement, and it contains no performance warranty from HDI. Subsection (a) (p0056-p0057) is a mutual corporate-authority representation (organization, power, enforceability, no conflict), and subsection (b) (p0058) is merely an acknowledgment about the Globix Agreement that benefits the Company. Nothing anywhere in the document warrants that HDI's design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site will be performed to any standard, conform to any specification, comply with law, or be free of malicious code, and there is no repair/re-performance/refund remedy. Searches for "workmanlike", "industry standard", "MERCHANTABILITY" and "AS IS" returned nothing, and Sections 1 and 5 impose only bare performance obligations (e.g., 1.6 operational deadline) rather than warranties.

The absence of a disclaimer means this is not walk-away territory, but the rule's fallback still requires an express performance warranty with a real remedy (90 days software / 30 days services). With zero warranty period and zero remedy, the clause fails the fallback on a material term, and the detection guidance expressly directs that a missing express warranty be treated as a deviation to be inserted. This is a genuine gap against HDI, the counterparty, and not an obligation that benefits us.

The proposed redline inserts a new Section 9(c) at the preferred position — workmanlike Services, a 90-day conformance period tied to the Company's written acceptance under Section 5.2, compliance with law, and no malicious code — with re-performance, repair/replacement, and a fee refund backstop if HDI does not cure within thirty days. The fallback of a 30-day services period is offered in the comment. Note that Section 10.7 already lists Section 9 as surviving for two years, so the inserted warranty carries survival without further edits.

proposal.summary: Add an HDI performance warranty (workmanlike Services, 90-day conformance, legal compliance, no malicious code) with a re-performance/repair/refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual authority representations, so HDI gives no warranty at all for the development, hosting and maintenance work it is paid to perform. We have added a standard performance warranty — workmanlike Services, a 90-day conformance period, compliance with law and no malicious code — with re-performance, repair or refund as our remedy. If a 90-day conformance period is an issue, we can accept 30 days for the Services portion.

ops.text: HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site (collectively, the "Services") will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with prevailing industry standards; (2) for a period of ninety (90) days following the Company's written acceptance and approval of the Site pursuant to Section 5.2, the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation agreed by the Parties; (3) HDI's performance of the Services will comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software delivered or used by HDI in performing the Services will be free of any virus, worm, disabling code or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at HDI's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services or repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site, and if HDI fails to do so within thirty (30) days of written notice from the Company, a refund of the fees paid by the Company with respect to the non-conforming Services.
